messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - spike in 5xx and increased latencies on /v1/generate for some tenants. Suspected smart-routing fallback loop involving model variant routing and cache reuse. Auto-pager to oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Ack. Jumping in. Any P0 customers impacted?
emma: Seeing 502s and repeated 'model variant mismatch' errors in the runtime logs. Appears requests intended for `redwood-onnx-quant` are being routed to `redwood-7b-v1` and then falling back back, creating a loop.
raj: Logs show KV cache keys are prefixed only by model_family, not variant+region. So when variant changes we reuse incompatible KV entries -> deserialization errors -> runtime triggers fallback to another variant.
mike: Paging graph shows >60% of failed calls originate from eu-west region buckets on the dedicated fleet. Could be routing policy that prefers region then variant; config shows `prefer_region: true` and `variant_aliasing: true`.
luis: I can repro locally with a small harness: set KV prefix to `model_family:rw` and then swap variant, cache hits produce corrupted kvblob on load. Code snippet:
```
# repro
PUT /kv/model_family:rw:123 -> blob for onnx quant
Switch variant -> GET /kv/model_family:rw:123 -> tries to interpret as 7b state -> crash
```
sarah: Immediate mitigation idea: change routing policy to disable aliasing+fallback for affected tenants and force strict variant matching, then evict relevant KV prefix. That should stop the loop.
oncall-sre: Good. Action list: 1) patch routing policy to strict for eu-west impacted pools, 2) clear KV prefix for model_family `redwood-onnx` in eu-west caches, 3) reroute traffic to healthy variant, 4) monitor. Who can run the prefix eviction?
emma: I can run the eviction script and apply the routing policy change. Will need a quick rollback plan.
jenny-cs: Which customers are affected? We have two enterprise customers on Dedicated in eu-west with real-time streams. They reported brief errors via support earlier.
raj: Querying the audit logs now for requests with header `X-Model-Alias`.
raj: Found correlated requests for tenant IDs T-8374 and T-9921. Error rate for those tenants jumped at approx when canary deploy of variant aliasing went live.
mike: Running the config change now: `redwoodctl routing set-policy --pool eu-west-dedicated --variant-match strict --dry-run=false`
emma: Applying KV eviction for prefix `model_family:redwood-onnx` on eu-west caches: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "model_family:redwood-onnx:*" | xargs redis-cli del`
luis: Heads up that eviction will cause some cold misses but better than corrupted KV.
oncall-sre: Go for it. Execute and document.
emma: Patch applied. KV eviction started. Rolling restarts of a subset of runtime pods to pick up strict routing.
sarah: Noted — update incident channel when the error rates drop and confirm customer impact status.
mike: Metrics: 5xxs dropped from 12% -> 2.1% over last 8 minutes. Latency p95 down from 1.8s -> 820ms.
jenny-cs: Notifying affected customers: sent templated note to T-8374 and T-9921 — notifying transient errors, mitigation underway, we will follow up.
raj: Found a config regression in the rollout script that allowed `variant_aliasing` to be enabled without KV prefix namespace isolation. Created PR to add a guard: require kv_namespace = variant_id when aliasing enabled.
luis: Also adding runtime validation to refuse loading a KV blob if metadata mismatch detected (model hash vs variant id) — will prevent deserialization causing fallback on corrupt data.
oncall-sre: Any remaining errors?
emma: Small error tail ~0.4% for a few minutes. Looks like some caches still stale in edge nodes. Running targeted cache flush on those nodes.
sarah: Customer impact assessment: Two enterprise customers saw transient errors lasting ~10 minutes, no data loss. Severity confirmed SEV2.
jenny-cs: Both customers acknowledged and asked for postmortem. Escalating to account lead for follow-up.
raj: Merged hotfix for routing guard. Deploying to prod with canary.
mike: Canary passed in us-east, rolling to eu-west now.
emma: Running post-incident checklist: create incident doc, record timeline, attach logs and graphs, assign owners for follow-up items.
oncall-sre: Handing off to day oncall emma for deep-clean and postmortem. I am available if the issue recurs.
emma: Oncall ack, taking ownership of postmortem and fixes.
sarah: Next steps / action items: [1] enforce KV namespace isolation for aliasing, [2] runtime metadata validation, [3] routing policy unit tests, [4] customer comms update and changelog. Owners: raj/luis/emma/jenny-cs. ETA 72hrs.
incident-bot: Incident auto-closed? No, marking as "Mitigated - monitoring". Will auto-escalate if error rate >1% again.
jenny-cs: Will follow up with customers and log support cases.
emma: Adding timeline to the incident doc now and linking dashboards.
oncall-sre: Thanks team. Great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
